On all fours facing the camera at a slight angle, she peels the robe off both shoulders so it pools at her elbows, catching her lower lip between her teeth in a first naughty bite while her eyes stay locked and inviting.

Kneeling and arching slightly, she slips both straps of the red bra a little lower on her shoulders without removing it, looking over one shoulder with a mischievous open-mouthed tease and lifted chin.
Curled on her side with the robe draped only over one arm, she gently cups the underside of her lace-covered breast through the fabric, lips parting as her gaze turns hungrier and more direct.

Settling into a low kneel with the robe fully open and slipping off, she runs both hands slowly down her sides to the panty hips as if ready to ease them, face blooming into a bold bitten-lip stare full of promise.
